replies.text: Credential vaults and guardrails are the parts where I would want someone else's notes. The quickstart repo helps too, since it turns the guide into something you can run.
The canvas an agent can create through a plugin is the feature I want to try. Congratulations on 1.6.0.
The recorded check outcomes are the detail I like most. Working from a phone is one thing, seeing what the agent actually ran is another.
Merging a pull request. I want to read the diff before it lands, even if the agent is sure.
